source.name: PianetaLecce, 'BetitalyPay e Lecce ancora insieme: accordo per altri tre anni'
source.quote: BetitalyPay e US Lecce proseguiranno insieme per altri tre anni

note: Three-year renewal signed 5 Aug 2026, keeping BetItalyPay as co-sponsor on the shirt; LecceSette (1 Aug 2026) had first reported the renewal for 2026/27. The previous agreement ran to 2025/26 (uslecce.it, 28 Jun 2023). No deal value reported.
